recommendation.text: The Board recommends that: (a) major construction projects be closely monitored and the contractual terms, including liquidated damages, enforced in the event of unjustified delay; (b) the Administration ensure greater accuracy and transparency in publishing the results of surveys relating to client satisfaction so that they can better serve their intended purpose as indicators for remedial action; and (c) a standard operating procedure be developed for the compilation and analysis of data for each key performance indicator.
